title: AMD Zen 6 Ryzen "Olympic Ridge" desktop CPUs expected in 2027
summary: AMD is reported to have delayed its Zen 6 Ryzen desktop "Olympic Ridge" CPUs to 2027, with an announcement expected around CES 2027 and launch anticipated in the first half of the year, after prioritizing the EPYC "Venice" server launch in mid-2026.

sources.title: AMD Next-Gen Ryzen "Olympic Ridge" Zen 6 Delayed to 2027
AMD Olympic Ridge "Zen 6" Ryzen Desktop CPUs Reportedly Launching In 2027

title: AWS discontinues Developer Support, Business Support, and Enterprise On-Ramp plans
summary: AWS will retire the Developer Support, Business Support, and Enterprise On-Ramp plans on January 1, 2027 (outside AWS GovCloud), migrating existing Business and Enterprise On-Ramp customers toward Business Support+ and Enterprise Support respectively.

sources.title: Developer, Business, and Enterprise On-Ramp end of support

title: Android developer-verification requirement expands globally
summary: After enforcement began September 30, 2026 for certified Android devices in Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand, Google has said it plans to expand its Play Integrity developer-verification requirement (which gates sideloading of unverified apps) to all certified Android devices globally in 2027; no specific month has been announced.

sources.title: Android's controversial new developer verification rules are officially here
Google Announces Android Sideloading Changes Timeline — Developer Verification Starts September in 4 Countries and Expands Globally in 2027

title: Google doubles Gemini Flash API prices as promotional rate ends
summary: Google's introductory pricing for Gemini 3.6/3.7/3.8 Flash ($0.75 input / $3.75 output per million tokens) expires December 31, 2026; standard list pricing of $1.50 input / $7.50 output takes effect January 1, 2027.

sources.title: Gemini API Pricing

title: Google launches two more Project Suncatcher prototype satellites with Planet
summary: Following an October 1, 2026 test launch of four TPUs on a prototype satellite, Google says two further Project Suncatcher prototype satellites built with Planet Labs are slated to launch by early 2027 as part of its solar-powered orbital AI-compute research program; exact date is not yet set beyond 'early 2027'.

sources.title: Meet Project Suncatcher, a research moonshot to scale machine learning compute in space
Project Suncatcher: Google to launch TPUs into orbit with Planet Labs

title: Google plans two-satellite Project Suncatcher follow-up launch
summary: Google plans to launch two satellites in 2027 to demonstrate optical inter-satellite links for Project Suncatcher, a step toward a theorized 81-satellite orbital AI-compute cluster.

sources.title: Project Suncatcher: Google to launch TPUs into orbit with Planet Labs

title: Google's EU DMA compliance deadlines for Android/Search AI interoperability
summary: Following the European Commission's July 16, 2026 final decisions, Google must begin sharing Search data with rival AI services by January 2027 and put Android AI-interoperability requirements, opening Gemini-equivalent access to competitors, in place by July 2027.

sources.title: Alphabet specification proceedings - Interoperability for AI services
EU warns Google: Gemini cannot be the only AI with deep Android integration

title: Google's EU-mandated search data sharing with rival search engines begins
summary: Under the European Commission's July 2026 Digital Markets Act gatekeeper decision, Google is required to begin sharing anonymised search data with competing search providers from January 2027, a deadline it is now contesting in court.

sources.title: Google appeals EU data-sharing order, warns of 'irreversible harm'

title: Azure East US 3 (Atlanta) region opens for all workloads
summary: Microsoft's new East US 3 region in the Atlanta metro area (Fulton and Douglas counties, Georgia) is set to open for all customer workloads in early 2027, adding Availability Zones to Azure's US footprint; the site already runs some AI supercomputing capacity.

sources.title: Microsoft will establish its next U.S. datacenter region in Georgia's Fulton and Douglas Counties
Microsoft to launch new cloud region in Atlanta, Georgia, in 2027

title: NSA's CNSA 2.0 mandate takes effect for new National Security Systems acquisitions
summary: Under the NSA's CNSA 2.0 transition timeline, new acquisitions for National Security Systems must support CNSA 2.0 post-quantum algorithms (ML-KEM-1024, ML-DSA-87, AES-256) starting January 1, 2027, unless an exception is explicitly documented.

sources.title: CNSA 2.0 and the 2027 Inflection Point
CNSA 2.0 Explained: PQC Requirements, Timelines, and Federal Impact

title: npm restricts bypass-2FA tokens to staged publishing only
summary: npm plans to cut direct publish capability for granular access tokens configured to bypass 2FA, reducing them to reading private packages and staging a publish that a maintainer must approve with 2FA; account/org/package-management actions for these tokens were already restricted on July 31, 2026.

sources.title: Restricting npm bypass-2FA granular access tokens

title: npm retires bypass-2FA token publishing
summary: Starting January 2027, npm granular access tokens configured to bypass 2FA can no longer publish packages directly; publishing is reduced to staging a release that requires a maintainer's separate 2FA-approved step before it becomes public.

sources.title: npm install-time security and GAT bypass2fa deprecation
Restricting npm bypass-2FA granular access tokens

title: Nvidia-Hugging Face acquisition expected to close
summary: Nvidia's roughly $12.9 billion definitive agreement to acquire Hugging Face (announced September 2-3, 2026) is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals.

title: California's SB 53 frontier AI incident-reporting duties take effect
summary: Provisions of California's Transparency in Frontier Artificial Intelligence Act (SB 53) take effect, including the Office of Emergency Services' duty to publish annual anonymized summaries of reported AI critical-safety incidents.

title: Washington State AI companion chatbot law takes effect
summary: Washington's HB 2225, signed by Gov. Bob Ferguson on March 24, 2026, requires AI companion chatbots to disclose AI-generated content, include self-harm safeguards, and protect minors, enforceable under the state Consumer Protection Act.

summary: Google Play's policy will no longer permit using the READ_CALL_LOG permission for phone-call account verification after this date; developers must migrate to the Digital Credentials API or SMS Retriever API.
